title: Cancellation, Suspension and Reinstatement of Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plans
content:
## Cancellation

**Condition C1.** Cancelling a Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plan is the rider's own decision. A cancelled plan records the date of cancellation, and its auto-renew setting is turned off.

**Condition C2.** An unused plan cancelled within the plan's full-refund window, counted in calendar days after purchase, is refunded in full; no plan is refunded pro rata after that. A plan is unused when no ride has been started under it.

## Suspension and reinstatement

**Condition S1.** A plan is suspended while any bike charge under it is unpaid. A suspended plan cannot unlock vehicles.

**Condition S2.** A suspended plan is reinstated when every unpaid charge is paid, without extending the term: its expiry date is unchanged by the suspension and by the reinstatement. Reinstatement is carried out by the support agent once every unpaid charge is paid.

**Condition S3.** A term that ends while the plan is suspended leaves the plan expired.

## C2 laid out

| Ride started under the plan | Cancelled within the full-refund window after purchase | Under C2 |
|---|---|---|
| no | yes | refunded in full |
| no | no | no full refund; no pro rata refund |
| yes | yes | not an unused plan; C2 gives no refund |
| yes | no | no full refund; no pro rata refund |

## Hypothetical cases

Taking, for illustration, a plan with a full-refund window of 14 calendar days, bought on 1 May:

1. No ride has been started and the rider cancels on 9 May, 8 calendar days after purchase. The plan is unused and inside the window: refunded in full.
2. One ride was started on 3 May and the rider cancels on 9 May. The plan is not unused; C2 gives no refund.
3. No ride has been started and the rider cancels on 20 June. The window has passed; the plan is not refunded pro rata.
4. A plan with two unpaid charges has one of them paid. One charge remains unpaid, so the plan stays suspended. Once the second is paid, the plan is reinstated, with the same last valid day it had before the suspension.
